nodes.description: IERC20 immutable token held by the TokenTimelock contract
immutable address of the beneficiary allowed to withdraw tokens
immutable uint256 timestamp after which release is enabled
TokenTimelock constructor: validates releaseTime_ against block.timestamp and initializes immutables
token() view accessor returning the held IERC20 token
beneficiary() view accessor returning the beneficiary address
releaseTime() view accessor returning the unlock timestamp
release() transfers all held tokens to the beneficiary once block.timestamp >= releaseTime
getLockedAmount() view returning the token balance currently locked in the contract
Address.sendValue forwards ETH with a low level call to an arbitrary payable recipient
Address.functionCallWithValue performs an arbitrary low level call with value and data
Address.functionDelegateCall performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a target with data
SafeERC20.safeTransfer wrapper encoding a token transfer call
SafeERC20.safeTransferFrom wrapper encoding a transferFrom call
SafeERC20.safeIncreaseAllowance adds value to the current allowance and approves
SafeERC20.safeDecreaseAllowance subtracts value from the allowance inside unchecked block
SafeERC20._callOptionalReturn performs optional-return token calls via Address.functionCall
Address.isContract uses extcodesize assembly to check whether an address holds code
block.timestamp used for the constructor release-time check and the release() gate
recipient.call{value: amount}("") low level ETH transfer to attacker-controlled address
target.call{value: value}(data) arbitrary external call forwarding value
target.delegatecall(data) executes untrusted code in the caller context
external token transfer to the beneficiary triggered at the end of release()
allowance + value arithmetic in safeIncreaseAllowance that can overflow/mis-account
inline assembly extcodesize inspection used for the contract-existence check
constructor parameter token_ assigned to _token
constructor parameter beneficiary_ assigned to _beneficiary
constructor parameter releaseTime_ assigned to _releaseTime
sendValue recipient address that becomes the low level call target
sendValue amount of wei forwarded in the low level call
target address of functionCallWithValue / functionDelegateCall
calldata payload passed to the low level call
wei value forwarded by functionCallWithValue
spender address approved in safeIncreaseAllowance
newAllowance computed as allowance + value in safeIncreaseAllowance
oldAllowance read before subtraction in safeDecreaseAllowance
returndata bytes returned by the optional low level token call
amount local holding the locked token balance inside release()

edges.reason: Constructor validation depends on the miner-influenced block.timestamp
release() gate compares block.timestamp against releaseTime(), a timestamp dependency
_releaseTime flows into the release() time check
_token is read via token() to compute the releasable balance
_beneficiary is read via beneficiary() as the transfer destination
_token is read to query the locked balance in getLockedAmount()
constructor parameter token_ is written to state variable _token
constructor parameter beneficiary_ is written to state variable _beneficiary
constructor parameter releaseTime_ is written to state variable _releaseTime
recipient address controls the low level ETH call target in sendValue
amount flows into the value of the low level ETH call
target address controls the external call destination in functionCallWithValue
data payload flows into the external low level call
value flows into the forwarded wei of the external call
spender is used when building the approve call in safeIncreaseAllowance
newAllowance = allowance + value feeds the arithmetic operation that may overflow
amount local (locked balance) becomes the value of the token transfer in release()
returndata from the token call is decoded/checked inside _callOptionalReturn
sendValue executes the low level ETH call
functionCallWithValue executes the arbitrary external call
functionDelegateCall executes the delegatecall operation
release() triggers the external token transfer to the beneficiary
safeIncreaseAllowance performs the allowance addition
isContract performs the extcodesize assembly check
release() calls token().safeTransfer to move the held tokens
safeTransfer routes through _callOptionalReturn
safeTransferFrom routes through _callOptionalReturn
safeIncreaseAllowance routes the approve call through _callOptionalReturn
safeDecreaseAllowance routes the approve call through _callOptionalReturn
_callOptionalReturn uses Address.functionCall for the token interaction
External call to recipient can re-enter the calling contract before state settles
Arbitrary external call target can call back into the caller
Token transfer to the beneficiary is an external call executed inside release() with no reentrancy guard

normalization_plan.reason: token_ is a constructor-only parameter whose value is stored into _token by the constructor
beneficiary_ is a constructor-only parameter whose value is stored into _beneficiary
releaseTime_ is a constructor-only parameter validated against block.timestamp and stored
recipient directly parameterizes the low level ETH call in sendValue
amount directly parameterizes the value of the low level ETH call in sendValue
target directly parameterizes the external call destination in functionCallWithValue
data directly parameterizes the calldata of the external call
value directly parameterizes the forwarded wei of the external call
spender is consumed by the allowance update/approve path in safeIncreaseAllowance
newAllowance is the direct result of the allowance addition arithmetic
oldAllowance is a temporary read used only inside safeDecreaseAllowance
returndata is a temporary local consumed only inside _callOptionalReturn
amount is a temporary local computed inside release() to size the token transfer
